items.name: LogMiner-QA
items.description: Turn production logs into test coverage using AI/ML. Automatically generates Gherkin test scenarios from application logs with banking-specific compliance and fraud detection modules.

items.name: frihet-mcp
items.description: Official MCP server for Frihet ERP — 157 tools for AI-powered invoicing, tax & e-invoicing compliance (VeriFactu, TicketBAI, Facturae), banking, CRM, HR/payroll & POS. Works with Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, ChatGPT.

items.name: CustIQ-360
items.description: CustIQ 360° is a multi-agent AI system that unifies banking modules (CASA, Lending, Wealth, KYC) into a single customer profile. It features a conversational query engine, cross-sell recommender, what-if simulator, compliance guardrails, and proactive alerts, reducing RM lookup time from ~30 min to under 2 min using Gemini Pro & Vision API.

items.name: AI-powered-banking-operations-knowledge-chatbot
items.description: AI-powered internal knowledge chatbot for banking operations using RAG architecture, FastAPI, React— finds SOPs, policies, compliance rules instantly.

items.name: bank-legal-advisor
items.description: AI-powered banking advisor that answers legal and compliance questions using retrieval-augmented generation over country-specific financial legislation, and assists in evaluating loan applications.

items.name: Fueleu-Maritime
items.description: A full-stack FuelEU Maritime Compliance Platform built using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Implements route emissions analysis, compliance balance calculation, banking, pooling, and comparison workflows following clean hexagonal architecture. Demonstrates strong engineering, domain modeling, and AI-assisted development practices.

items.name: banking-copilot
items.description: Banking AI Copilot using CRAG (Corrective RAG) with FastAPI, LangChain, FAISS, and Streamlit. The system performs self-reflective retrieval, query rewriting, compliance checks, fraud/KYC support, and structured loan-rate lookups with guardrails.

items.name: banking-compliance-rag-chatbot
items.description: AI-powered RAG chatbot for banking regulations and compliance queries. Built with LangChain, ChromaDB, Groq AI, and Streamlit. It enables intelligent querying across Basel, FATF, RBI, and UAE regulatory frameworks, with an in-depth approach to document chunking for improved accuracy and context retrieval.

items.name: 4-cybersecurity-social-engineering-project-ai-risk-intelligence-financial-incidents-analytics
items.description: 🔐4- Cybersecurity -Social Engineering - Modular end-to-end AI-powered risk intelligence infrastructure for banking and fintech incidents analytics, integrating semantic analysis, interactive dashboards, APIs and LLM-powered insights to support governance, compliance and regulatory decision-making.

items.name: vigil
items.description: A production-ready, multi-agent AI system designed to automate email compliance monitoring for the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector. This system leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and advanced orchestration to detect policy violations, security risks, and anomalous communication patterns at scale.
